Key points
• Nutraceuticals are products falling between nutritional and pharmaceutical product categories.
• There is no clear and comprehensive deﬁnition for nutraceuticals approved by international authorities, which is needed to
regulate their safety or therapeutic efﬁcacy.
• Nutraceuticals are generally comprised of ingredients derived from foods and herbs.
• Health beneﬁts of nutraceuticals must be substantiated by clinical evidence, with preclinical data used to support mech-
anisms of action.
